snippet.title: Mighty Arms - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist On Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672440

Mighty Arms is a unique physics-based movement brawler where you smash robots, upgrade your talents, and battle through a busted construction site after tech genius Elon Fusk loses control.

Join our Discord for the latest news and potential access to Playtests!:
https://discord.gg/PR2NdTg6GP

Follow us on instagram!: 
https://www.instagram.com/nebulanookgames/

Step into the boots of John Builder.
Elon Fusk’s construction bots went crazy, and you, a tired worker, are the last line of defense.
Swing your fists through metal, bricks, and stone to defend what’s left of the job site and maybe humanity. Crack skulls, punch robots, sip coffee.
It’s just another day on the world’s most dangerous construction site.
Now get back to work!

- Chaotic physics based movement and combat
- Different enemies and bosses to beat
- A wide range of unlockable skills
- Silly characters
